items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: There's a guy named Al Sears. I think he was a tenor player, and he was with -- Duke for quite a spell... Al Sears and three or four of his musicians came in one night... I heard our riff. They've called it 'Castle Rock' and Al Sears or so and so recorded it

ctx.x: We were playing this with my five piece group, and this was the riff. There's a guy named Al Sears. I think he was a tenor player, and he was with --
